title: Counting with Counter
description: Counter tallies occurrences and most_common returns the top items as (element, count) pairs.

steps.description: Reveal import: Counter from collections for counting.
Reveal Counter creation: counts red twice and blue once from the list.
Reveal first print: shows the Counter object with element: count pairs.
Reveal most_common: returns list of tuples, then extracts the top element's name.
Run to show red as the most common element.
